title: Is it more important if an actor has an acting range or if he has one or two types that nobody could play better?

commenti.body:
Firstly your English doesn't suck. Secondly yeah Denzel Washington is awesome.

The concept of 'the greatest' is a bit difficult though. I don't think there will ever be a consensus on what that even means, let-alone who takes the title\*.

I would agree that Denzel broadly seems to stick to a particular type of character. Maybe you'd say that's a lack of range but it seems preferable to him doing a load of films where it doesn't quite click. Some people are just naturally charismatic and authoritative. It certainly makes sense for directors/casting to use that to their advantage.

\*I mean it's PSH, but that's besides the point.
